title: Report status and keep logs
acceptance:
Story: the operator can see what the server is and what it did.
Expected: GET /status without auth reports version, readiness and schema version, and the server logs sign-ins, sign-outs, revocations, invitations, writes, deletes and refusals as single JSON lines on the console.
Not expected: a log web view, rotation or remote log shipping.
Depends on: WI-11 schema version and the routes of S6 and S7.
Verify: acceptance reads status and observes a log line for each event it drives.
evidence: GET /status reports version 0.2, ready and the schema version; JSON log lines cover sign-in, sign-out, revoked, invitation, account-created, write, delete, folder and refusal, asserted by verify.py. PR #6: https://github.com/chakibelbassam/FoundationOS/pull/6.
